goal: Ship WS-319: TVR Gate 4 Phase A — fix the coordinate system, the touch floor, and the overflow behaviour the rest of the redesign designs within

items.title: TVR Gate 4 Phase A — the geometry decision: does the command column keep living inside the uniform scale transform?

decisions_needed: Item WS-319: Option (b) ends the single-uniform-canvas model that every view in this app currently shares (ShowdownView, HandReplayView and the drills all use ScaledContainer). Decide whether the geometry change is TableView-only or app-wide. TableView-only is cheaper but creates two layout idioms in one product — which is the kind of drift sidebar-shell-spec.md exists to prevent.
Item WS-319: If (b) is chosen, WS-311 should be closed BY this work rather than fixed separately — fixing it first would be work done twice.
composition_notes:
